James McIntyre, Poetry.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/james-mcintyre/poetry

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- James McIntyre, the author, died 1906 (Wikidata Q6139403, P570 = 1906-03-31).

First publication of the text used: Between 1884 and 1889 (SE colophon: 'Poetry was published between 1884 and 1889 by James McIntyre.'). The Wikipedia article says his pieces ran in the Toronto Globe, that he lived in Upper Canada and Ingersoll, Ontario, and that his volume Poems of James McIntyre appeared in 1889.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published between 1884 and 1889, before 1931, so the US rule settles the US side too. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it by 1984.
- Country of origin (Canada): Canada's term for this author is life plus 50 years, which ended for him on 1 January 1957 (last to die 1906). The 2022 extension to life plus 70 years applies only to works still in copyright on 30 December 2022.
